Ana — thanks for sending this over. We're excited to run the evals. Quick responses inline and a proposed MAP below.

Short answers:
- Usage constraints: Redwood can run the supplied testcases and prompt pack for the purpose of evaluation and functional validation only. We will not use the dataset for model training or benchmarking outside of this engagement. We propose 60 days retention from the date of receipt; we can extend to 90 days if Acme signs the evaluation addendum.
- Export / derived outputs: Redwood will provide evaluation artifacts (metrics, flagged examples, logs) in a shared folder. We will not ship raw testcases back to third parties.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) 2025-07-15: Acme uploads testcases & prompt pack to shared Drive (Ana) — COMPLETE
2) 2025-07-16: Redwood confirms ingestion & runs smoke tests (Sozo / Soojin)
3) 2025-07-18: Initial evaluation results (latency, per-prompt accuracy, regressions) delivered to Acme (Marissa)
4) 2025-07-22: Joint result review + decision on next steps (canary rollout or contract signature)
5) 2025-07-30: Target close for Dedicated capacity/contract signature (Procurement / Legal)

Owners: Soojin (Redwood POC), Marissa (performance lead), Dev (ingest/ops). Can you confirm owners on your side?

I attached a one-page MAP doc and a stub for the prompt-pack handling agreement. We also recommend the following minimal dataset metadata to speed the ingest: id, prompt_text, expected_output, label_category, sensitivity (none/low/medium/high).

We will not begin any persistent storage of the dataset until we have a signed evaluation addendum; smoke tests and ephemeral processing are fine to start immediately.

Next steps: Confirm whether Acme needs an NDA or evaluation addendum first, and confirm the timeline for Procurement sign-off. If you sign off on the MAP above, we'll schedule an ingestion window tomorrow morning (07/16).

Thanks — talk soon.
